name: Tennessee State University
tuition_note: In-state undergraduate tuition & fees $9,568 (on & off campus) and on-campus undergraduate housing $5,152 from tnstate.edu Cost of Attendance page (/financial_aid/costofattendance.aspx), 2026-2027 estimated cost of attendance (same figures also shown for 2025-26). Housing is the room allowance; meal plans are priced separately via campusdish, so treated as room only.
